stationId.description: Must match the station that currently owns the active claim. Must be non-empty: the API treats "" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.

quantity.description: RELOCATE only (ADR-0047): the units the operator counted and moved (v1 moves the whole on-hand quantity of the SKU at the source bin). Required for a RELOCATE task, rejected (422 `not-relocation-task`) for any other. A value below 1 is a 400.

fromBin.description: RELOCATE only: the source bin the operator scanned. Required when the move left the source open (an Assign); when sent for a planned source it must equal it. A blank value (no character outside ECMA-262 `\s`) is a 400.

toBin.description: RELOCATE only: the destination bin the operator scanned. Required when the move left the destination open (a Vacate); when sent for a planned destination it must equal it. A blank value (no character outside ECMA-262 `\s`) is a 400.

relocateVacate.summary: A RELOCATE Vacate move - the reserve destination was scanned
